# A free ActivInspire alternative for any panel

> A free, open-source alternative to Promethean ActivInspire for any interactive panel. Compare editions, price, platforms, AI and recording. Facts checked November 2026.

Canonical: https://rupok.app/compare/activinspire/ · Language: en · Updated: 2026-11-23

ActivInspire is Promethean’s long-running flipchart software, with a free Personal Edition and a paid Professional Edition. Rupok is free with every feature, runs in the browser, and adds AI-made lessons and class replay.

## Rupok vs ActivInspire at a glance

*Rupok and ActivInspire compared, as of November 2026*

|  | Rupok | ActivInspire |
|---|---|---|
| Price | ✓ Free, every feature, on every device. No licence keys | ◐ Personal Edition is a free download; Professional comes with some ActivPanels or costs US$1,249 per device (US list price, Jan 2026)[^1][^2] |
| Open source | ✓ Yes: AGPL-3.0. The `.rpk` format spec is Apache-2.0 | ✗ No |
| Runs on | Chrome or Edge on Windows, macOS, Linux and ChromeOS. Desktop app for Windows and Linux: coming soon | Windows, macOS and Ubuntu[^1]. No web, ChromeOS or mobile app |
| AI | ✓ Live Smart Objects made by the AI you already use: Claude, Codex or OpenCode over MCP, or HTML pasted from any chatbot | ✗ None found[^1] |
| Replay and recording | ✓ Stroke-by-stroke replay of every page, built in. Replay with audio: coming soon | ◐ Screen and sound recorder in Professional only[^1] |
| Interactive content | ✓ AI-made simulations, 3D models and quizzes that run live on the slide | ✓ Activities, polls and learner-response devices; question manager and actions in Professional[^1] |
| PDF and slides | ✓ Import a PDF and write on every page; Download PDF | ◐ PDF import and export in Professional only[^1] |
| Bangla | ◐ Bangla text and fonts in lessons. Bangla interface: coming soon | ✗ About 33 interface languages, no Bangla[^1] |
| Smartboards and panels | ✓ Any smartboard, interactive panel, projector or laptop with Chrome or Edge | ✓ Works with a wide range of interactive whiteboards and panels[^1] |
| File format | Open `.rpk` (a ZIP package with a published spec) | `.flipchart`; imports SMART Notebook files[^1]; exports `.iwb`[^6] |
| Status (Nov 2026) | Actively developed, pre-alpha (first public release) | Still offered. Latest build we could verify: 3.5.18 (Jan 2025)[^3]. Promethean’s newest software is ActivSuite (launched Jan 2025)[^4] |

## Where ActivInspire is stronger

Being honest about this saves you time.

- **Years of flipcharts.** Many schools have large libraries of `.flipchart` lessons and Promethean resource packs.
- **Deep authoring tools** in Professional: actions, the question manager and self-paced learning[^1].
- **Learner-response hardware** (ActivVote, ActivExpression) and Express Poll[^1].
- **Imports SMART Notebook files**[^1] and exports IWB files[^6].
- **A Linux build**, alongside Windows and macOS[^1][^3].

## Where Rupok is stronger

- **Every feature is free.** Recording, PDF import and export aren’t locked behind a paid edition.
- **Runs in the browser**, on Windows, macOS, Linux and ChromeOS, with nothing to install.
- **AI Smart Objects:** live simulations and quizzes from the AI you already use.
- **Replay for every student:** a small `.rpk` file they open in any browser.
- **Bangla text in lessons** and an open file format, so lessons aren’t locked to one vendor.
- **Actively developed** in the open, with a public roadmap.

## Which one should you pick?

**Pick ActivInspire** if your school has a big flipchart library, uses Promethean learner-response devices, or needs Professional’s authoring tools.

**Pick Rupok** if you want every feature free on any panel, AI-made interactive lessons, and replays students can open at home.

## Switching from ActivInspire

1. **Export from ActivInspire.** Professional exports flipcharts to PDF[^1]; with Personal Edition, print to PDF.
2. **Open the board.** Go to [rupok.app/board](https://rupok.app/board/) in Chrome or Edge, on the panel's PC or your laptop. No install, no account.
3. **Drop the PDF in.** Every page becomes a slide you can write on.
4. **Add the live parts.** Ask your AI for a simulation or quiz and drop it on a slide as a Smart Object ([how](https://rupok.app/ai-whiteboard/)).
5. **Save and share.** Save the lesson as a `.rpk` file and send it to students. They replay it at [rupok.app/open](https://rupok.app/open/).

## Rupok and ActivInspire: questions

### Is ActivInspire being discontinued?

We found no announced end date as of November 2026. Promethean’s newest classroom software is ActivSuite[^4]. It retired ClassFlow at the end of 2023, saying that wouldn’t affect ActivInspire[^5].

### Is ActivInspire free?

The Personal Edition is a free download. The Professional Edition comes with some ActivPanels or costs US$1,249 per device on Promethean’s January 2026 US price list[^1][^2].

### Can Rupok open .flipchart files?

No. Export or print the flipchart to PDF and drop it into Rupok. (SMART Notebook can import flipcharts, if you need the objects kept.)

### Does Rupok work on a Promethean ActivPanel?

Yes, from Chrome or Edge on the panel’s computer. Rupok works with any panel’s touch and pen like any browser app.

# An Explain Everything alternative with free, unlimited replay

> Compare Rupok with Explain Everything: free plan limits, pricing, platforms, recording vs stroke replay, AI and languages. Facts checked November 2026, with sources.

Canonical: https://rupok.app/compare/explain-everything/ · Language: en · Updated: 2026-11-23

Explain Everything, now part of Promethean, records polished video lessons on tablets, with a limited free plan. Rupok replays every stroke of your class from a small file, free and without limits, and runs on your classroom board.

## Rupok vs Explain Everything at a glance

*Rupok and Explain Everything compared, as of November 2026*

|  | Rupok | Explain Everything |
|---|---|---|
| Price | ✓ Free, every feature, on every device. No licence keys | ◐ Free plan: 3 projects, 1 slide per project, 3-minute videos. Advanced US$69/year (education); Pro US$7.49/month billed yearly[^1] |
| Open source | ✓ Yes: AGPL-3.0. The `.rpk` format spec is Apache-2.0 | ✗ No |
| Runs on | Chrome or Edge on Windows, macOS, Linux and ChromeOS. Desktop app for Windows and Linux: coming soon | iPad, iPhone, Android, Chromebook and a browser app[^1] |

## Where Explain Everything is stronger

Being honest about this saves you time.

- **Polished video lessons:** record with your voice, edit, add captions and export MP4[^2]. Rupok replays strokes; replay with audio is coming.
- **Native tablet apps** for iPad, iPhone and Android that work offline[^1][^4].
- **Real-time collaboration** on paid plans[^1].
- **Many export formats:** video, PDF, images and GIFs[^2].
- **On-device AI** for activities and lesson plans on recent Apple devices[^2][^5].

## Where Rupok is stronger

- **No limits on the free plan:** unlimited lessons, pages and replay length.
- **Replay, not video:** students get every stroke in a small file. They can pause, zoom and still use the live Smart Objects, which a video can’t do.
- **AI from any assistant**, not tied to an Apple device or a paid plan: Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or OpenCode.
- **Built for the classroom board:** fast GPU ink on smartboards and panels in Chrome or Edge.
- **Bangla text in lessons**, and open source.

## Which one should you pick?

**Pick Explain Everything** if you make narrated video lessons on an iPad, or need collaboration on tablets.

**Pick Rupok** if you teach live on a board or in an online class and want free, unlimited replays and AI-made interactive lessons.

## Switching from Explain Everything

1. **Export your project as PDF.** Explain Everything exports PDF[^2].
2. **Open the board.** Go to [rupok.app/board](https://rupok.app/board/) in Chrome or Edge, on the panel's PC or your laptop. No install, no account.
3. **Drop the PDF in.** Every page becomes a slide you can write on.
4. **Add the live parts.** Ask your AI for a simulation or quiz and drop it on a slide as a Smart Object ([how](https://rupok.app/ai-whiteboard/)).
5. **Save and share.** Save the lesson as a `.rpk` file and send it to students. They replay it at [rupok.app/open](https://rupok.app/open/).

## Rupok and Explain Everything: questions

### Is Explain Everything free?

There’s a free plan with 3 projects, 1 slide per project and 3-minute videos. Paid plans start at US$69 a year for education (Advanced) or US$7.49 a month billed yearly (Pro)[^1].

### Who owns Explain Everything?

Promethean acquired Explain Everything in November 2022[^3].

### How is Rupok’s replay different from a video?

Rupok saves each pen stroke with its timing, so a replay redraws the lesson. The file stays small, students can zoom in, and live Smart Objects keep working. It has no sound yet; replay with audio is coming.

# Rupok vs OneNote for teaching on a board

> OneNote is a great notebook; Rupok is built for teaching from a smartboard. Compare price, ink replay, AI, Class Notebook, platforms and Bangla. Facts checked November 2026.

Canonical: https://rupok.app/compare/onenote/ · Language: en · Updated: 2026-11-23

Many teachers write on OneNote at the front of the class. OneNote is a superb notebook for every device. Rupok is built for presenting: slides, a Teach mode for the board, live AI-made objects, and a replay students can open anywhere.

## Rupok vs OneNote at a glance

*Rupok and OneNote compared, as of November 2026*

|  | Rupok | OneNote |
|---|---|---|
| Price | ✓ Free, every feature, on every device. No licence keys | ◐ Free to download and use; Ink Replay, Math Assistant and Copilot need Microsoft 365 or Copilot subscriptions[^1][^5] |
| Open source | ✓ Yes: AGPL-3.0. The `.rpk` format spec is Apache-2.0 | ✗ No |
| Runs on | Chrome or Edge on Windows, macOS, Linux and ChromeOS. Desktop app for Windows and Linux: coming soon | Windows, Mac, web, iPhone, iPad and Android[^1] |
| Account | ✓ None, for teachers or students | A Microsoft account (the Windows app can also keep local notebooks)[^1] |

| Replay and recording | ✓ Stroke-by-stroke replay of every page, built in. Replay with audio: coming soon | ◐ Ink Replay redraws strokes in order, on Windows only[^2] |
| Interactive content | ✓ AI-made simulations, 3D models and quizzes that run live on the slide | Notes, ink and embedded files |
| PDF and slides | ✓ Import a PDF and write on every page; Download PDF | ✓ Insert PDF printouts and ink on them; export to PDF[^8] |
| Bangla | ◐ Bangla text and fonts in lessons. Bangla interface: coming soon | ◐ Bangla (Bangladesh) gets proofing tools only; Bangla (India) is partly localized[^6] |
| Offline | ◐ Runs on your device once the board is open. Offline install: coming soon | ✓ Native apps work offline and sync later[^9] |
| Real-time collaboration | ◷ Live class and share links: coming soon with Rupok Cloud | ✓ Co-editing; Class Notebook gives each student a private section[^3] |
| Status (Nov 2026) | Actively developed, pre-alpha (first public release) | Actively developed. OneNote for Windows 10 reached end of support on 14 Oct 2025[^4] |

## Where OneNote is stronger

Being honest about this saves you time.

- **Notebooks on every device**, with offline work and sync[^1][^9].
- **Class Notebook:** private student sections, a read-only content library, a collaboration space, page distribution and feedback, with rosters from Teams or an LMS[^3].
- **Co-editing** and a huge Microsoft 365 ecosystem; Office 365 A1 is free for eligible schools[^7].
- **Math Assistant and handwriting search** (Math Assistant needs a qualifying subscription).

## Where Rupok is stronger

- **Built for presenting:** slide pages, a Teach mode that keeps the slide fitted to the board, and clicker support.
- **Live Smart Objects:** simulations and quizzes made by your AI, running on the slide.
- **Replay anywhere:** students replay every stroke in any browser. OneNote’s Ink Replay is Windows-only[^2].
- **No account** for teachers or students.
- **Fast GPU ink** that stays smooth through a long class.
- **Open source,** with Bangla text in lessons.

## Which one should you pick?

**Pick OneNote** for class notebooks, homework distribution and notes across every device in a Microsoft 365 school.

**Pick Rupok** for teaching at the board: writing on slides, live AI-made objects, and replays for students.

Plenty of teachers use both: OneNote for the notebook, Rupok for the lesson.

## Moving a OneNote lesson to Rupok

1. **Export the pages as PDF.** OneNote exports pages, sections or notebooks to PDF on Windows, and single pages on the web and Mac[^8].
2. **Open the board.** Go to [rupok.app/board](https://rupok.app/board/) in Chrome or Edge, on the panel's PC or your laptop. No install, no account.
3. **Drop the PDF in.** Every page becomes a slide you can write on.
4. **Add the live parts.** Ask your AI for a simulation or quiz and drop it on a slide as a Smart Object ([how](https://rupok.app/ai-whiteboard/)).
5. **Save and share.** Save the lesson as a `.rpk` file and send it to students. They replay it at [rupok.app/open](https://rupok.app/open/).

## Rupok and OneNote: questions

### Is OneNote free for teachers?

OneNote is free to download and use. Some features, such as Ink Replay and Math Assistant, and Copilot need a Microsoft 365 or Copilot subscription[^1][^5]. Eligible schools can get Office 365 A1 for free[^7].

### Does OneNote replay handwriting?

Yes, Ink Replay redraws strokes in order, but only on Windows[^2]. Rupok’s replay works in any browser, including students’ phones.

### Should I switch from OneNote to Rupok?

Not necessarily. Keep OneNote for notebooks and use Rupok for presenting at the board, where slides, live objects and replay matter.
